channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US Treasury secretary says new economic measures will ‘collapse’ Iran
item.description: Scott Bessent has not said if countries such as China could be targeted in an effort to economically isolate Tehran.

item.title: North Korea fires ballistic missiles as US-South Korea drills near end
item.description: South Korea convened an emergency security meeting following the launches, as Trump seeks to sway Pyongyang.

item.title: Deadly Russian missile barrage hits Kyiv in hours-long overnight attack
item.description: Russia launched a hours-long overnight barrage of ballistic and cruise missiles and drones across Kyiv.

item.title: US says sanctions will 'squash' Iran's economy and 'collapse' its regime
item.description: The US treasury secretary says allies will need to decide whether they "are with us or against us".

item.title: UK, France, Germany, Italy and Canada condemn Israel's West Bank settlement project
item.description: European countries and Canada pile on pressure over Israel's plans to expand settlements in a strategically vital part of the occupied West Bank.

item.title: Russia 'purposefully' hit critical infrastructure in latest strikes, Kyiv mayor says
item.description: At least 17 people were killed in the "massive attack" overnight on Ukraine's capital, as mayor Vitali Klitschko warns hot water supply has been disrupted.

item.title: Ex-Zambian minister killed in security raid on opposition
item.description: Police confirm Mutotwe Kafwaya's death after growing demands for information about his whereabouts.

item.title: Israel confirms soldiers fired at car in which Hind Rajab was killed and opens criminal investigation
item.description: The five-year-old Palestinian girl initially survived the attack and pleaded for help but her body was recovered later with those of six of her relatives.

item.title: Australia 'outraged' after Israel decides not to open criminal investigation into killing of aid worker in Gaza
item.description: Australia's foreign minister summoned the Israeli ambassador over "insulting" Zomi Frankcom decision.

item.title: Multiple deadly Israeli strikes in Gaza in under 24 hours
item.description: BBC Verify looks at footage from two deadly strikes in under 24 hours in Gaza.
